about: ROM-free regression checkpoint of the fold's compiler-selected first-party source closure after comparison with main 4e461ea (v1.0.15 plus later main commits). Includes are pinned; comments and whitespace are ignored. It is a source comparison only: not a release reproduction, not binary identity, not cross-play or platform qualification.

comparison.not_compared_for_this_reference: Per-TU compile settings, preprocessed tokens, objects and link lines. Those levels were compared for d457741 only (git history of this file).

reference_input_limitations.configure: Release chain configured with BUILD_TESTING=OFF: with tests on, the capsule's camera overlay rejects the storage module registered before it.
reference_input_limitations.scope: The reference uses retained private payloads from the v1.0.11 probe, so its computed owned IDs are not the shipped ones. Its four engine salts are the shipped v1.0.15 values (found in the official Windows and Linux x86_64 runtimes).

post_fold_changes.reason: Owned heap/menu release fixtures: the checkpointed dispatch prefix of dkr_probe_native moved into probe_native_entry.h (same calls, same order, early return when handled) and dkr_probe_native_fields moved unchanged into probe_native_fields.h, included at the end of the file. Reviewed: the moved fields body is textually identical, and -O2 v77 objects differ only in register allocation and stack slots.

Race-release Before control: the stale and duplicate Go guards moved unchanged into release_disposition() in party_release.hpp; the two log lines became one fprintf choosing 'stale' or 'duplicate' with identical text. Shipped builds resolve the header from src/game.

Spectator-admission Before control: the three preparing_music() calls go through resident_music_admitted() in resident_music_admission.hpp, which returns preparing_music(). Shipped builds resolve the header from src/game.

Vehicle original-textures Before control: the texture-profile admission moved into texture_profile_admitted() in vehicle_texture_profile.hpp (the old rejection condition is exactly its negation). Shipped builds resolve the header from src/game.
